## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for a user or contributor.

## Verification

List the commands actually run, results, platform-specific skips and any remaining acceptance step. Distinguish synthetic tests from live application checks.

## Review

- [ ] The diff contains no machine configuration, credentials, private project data, runtime state, screenshots or raw logs.
- [ ] Tool/configuration changes are reflected in documentation and agent routes.
- [ ] Existing configurations and uncertain-operation behavior were considered.
- [ ] The manifest was rebuilt after the final release-file edit when applicable.
